body:
native/sip-jni-proof/ now builds hermetically via Bazel 9.2.0: rules_cc cc_library/cc_binary(linkshared) for libcarepyre_sip.so, java_test for the real JNI smoke test, jni.h/jni_md.h from @bazel_tools//tools/jdk:jni against a hermetic remotejdk_21 (no system JDK needed -- verified live). CI's sip-jni-proof job now runs through bazel build/bazel test instead of raw gcc/javac/java. Both bazel build //... and bazel test //... pass clean. android/ (Gradle) deliberately stays out of Bazel -- rules_android needs an Android SDK/NDK this sandbox can't reach. Commit 3d7f3bb.

⚓ ☃
title: CP-OPS-1244: CarePyre SIP phone builds under Bazel
